description: This pie chart, titled "Token Routing Distribution (FedHLM)," visually represents the distribution of token routing across three categories: "LOCAL," "LLM," and "EDGE_P2P." The chart is composed of three distinct slices, with the largest segment, colored a dark olive green, representing "LOCAL" and accounting for 94.5% of the total. The second largest slice, labeled "LLM" and colored a reddish-brown, constitutes 3.9% of the distribution. The smallest slice, labeled "EDGE_P2P" and colored a muted blue-gray, represents 1.6%. Each category is explicitly labeled both within its corresponding slice and in a legend positioned to the upper left, with percentage values clearly displayed inside each respective slice. The slices are arranged in descending order of size, with the "LOCAL" segment occupying the majority of the chart's area.
